texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

当维护机制解除后，星系内的其他L-星门在自纠错软件的调整之下也会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们现在可以毫无阻碍的探索星团，这让我们比其他人领先一大步。
texts.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort their maintenance cycle. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

As the maintenance cycle ends, any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years as their self-correcting software readjusts. Still, this will give us a significant headstart to explore the cluster without interference.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已经掌握了足够多的关于L-星门的知识和技术，现在可以移除锁住传送门的维护机制了。如果成功的话，位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门应该能让我们立刻到达遥远的L-星团。

虽然星系内的其他L-星门会在几年内逐一恢复使用，但率先使用L-星门的我们显然可以比其他人领先一大步。
texts.en:
Our scientists are now confident that our knowledge of the L-Gates and the technology behind them is sufficient to abort the maintenance cycle they have been locked into. If the attempt is successful, the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system should allow immediate access to the distant L-Cluster.

Any additional L-Gates in the galaxy will likely also become operational within a matter of years, but this should give us a significant headstart.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]的科学家们与某个遥远星团建立起了永久的连接，他们将那个与我们星系隔离的星团称之为“L-星团”，但此举导致我们星系被来自那个星团的纳米机器人疯狂入侵！

那些纳米机器人是从被称为“L-星门”的亚空间传送门中蜂拥而出的，任何与它们的联络交流都以失败告终。当它们从星门中涌出的时候，我们也检测到了L-星团流过来的能源信号。
texts.en:
Scientists from the [From.GetName] have somehow established a permanent connection to a distant group of stars, referred to by their astronomers as the "L-Cluster,"  that had previously been isolated from the galaxy. Unfortunately, this has, in turn, triggered an invasion of our galaxy by the cluster's inhabitants - aggressive nanomachines that attack everything in sight!

They are emerging from subspace portals designated as L-Gates, and any attempts to communicate with them have failed. In the wake of their passage through the gates, we have detected emanating from the cluster they came from.

texts.zh:
传感器侦测到数个同步的亚空间扰动，最近的一个位于[disturbance_system.GetName]星系。

扰动正在迅速减弱，但我们仍未判明造成扰动的原因。
texts.en:
Sensors indicate several synchronous subspace disruptions, the closest one reported in the [disturbance_system.GetName] system.

The disturbances are rapidly subsiding, but we have yet to determine what caused them.

texts.zh:
我们打开了通往L-星团的大门，却发现另一边有什么东西在等着我们。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为L-星龙的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
texts.en:
We pried open the gate to the L-Cluster, only to find something waiting for us on the other side. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gates had been fully stabilized, it broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the L-Drake has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

texts.zh:
[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系内的L-星门开启了，传送门网络似乎被另一个帝国打开了。在亚空间的旧伤口被撕开，但L-星门完全稳定之前，它穿了过来。

一只被仓促地命名为L-星龙的巨大生物出现在了[dragons_current_system.GetName]星系，而惊慌失措的报告表明星系内的L-星门星系都在发生类似的情况。

[dragons_current_system.GetName]貌似并无敌意，而且已经开始移动。它似乎正在寻找什么东西，但预测表明其最终目的地是[dragons_target.GetName]星系。

它不太可能会在那里找到它想找的东西。
texts.en:
The L-Gate in the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system has become active, the network seemingly pried open by a foreign state. After the old wounds in subspace had been torn open but before the L-Gate had fully stabilized, something broke through.

A giant creature hastily dubbed the L-Drake has emerged into the [dragons_current_system.GetName] system, and frenzied reports indicate that similar scenes are playing out in all L-Gate systems across the galaxy.

The [dragons_current_system.GetName] specimen does not appear hostile, and it is already on the move. It appears to be searching for something, but projections put its final destination down as the [dragons_target.GetName] system.

It is unlikely to find whatever it is looking for, there.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经设法恢复了通往L-星团的道路！被称为L-星龙的巨大生物从每个现有的L-星门中出现，但他们似乎未展示出敌意。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] has managed to restore access to the L-Cluster! Giant creatures known as L-Drakes are emerging from every existing L-Gate, although they do not yet appear to be hostile.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]已经成功开启了L-星团，却意外地发现它已经被一个名叫德萨努协和国的高等文明占据了！
texts.en: The [From.GetName] have successfully unlocked the L-Cluster, only to reveal that it is already inhabited by an advanced civilization known as the Dessanu Consonance!

texts.zh:
成功了！我们的技术人员移除了位于[candidate_gateway_system.GetName]星系的L-星门的维护机制。

我们将是这亿万年来第一批从我们的星系进入L-星团的人！
texts.en:
Success! Our technicians managed to abort the maintenance cycle, and the lockdown has been removed from the L-Gate in the [candidate_gateway_system.GetName] system.

For the first time in eons, the L-Cluster can now be accessed from our galaxy!

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的L-星团了。

但这样一来，我们就无法启动我们这个星系的L-星门了。现在除了已经可以正常使用的那个L-星门之外，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。

现在如果我们想前往遥远星团的话，只能使用[From.GetName]掌控之下的那个传送门了！
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

Unfortunately, this has halted our own project to activate an L-Gate. Aside from the one that is functional, all other L-Gates in the galaxy have now activated some sort of self-correcting software that should terminate their maintenance cycles within a matter of years.

For now, however, the only way to reach the star cluster is through the gate belonging to the [From.GetName]!

texts.zh: [From.GetName]在自己境内成功地恢复了某种远古亚空间传送门的电源，现在他们能到达我们星系边缘的某个被隔离的星团了！这个星团被他们称为“L-星团”，这个星团无法经由超空间抵达，只能通过这些L-星门。
texts.en: By restoring power to some sort of ancient subspace gateway within their borders, the [From.GetName] has gained access to an isolated star cluster on the periphery of our galaxy! This group of stars, which they refer to as the "L-Cluster," cannot be reached by hyperlane - only through these L-Gates.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]移除了在他们掌控之下的L-星门上的封锁机制！他们现在可以通过L-星门来进入遥远的星团了。

在他们的L-星门恢复正常使用的那一刻起，星系中所有其他的L-星门都启动了某种自纠错软件功能，此功能将让这些L-星门在几年后自动停止其内部的维护机制。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has managed to remove the lockdown from the L-Gate under their control! They now have full access to the distant L-Cluster.

As an apparent side-effect of this, all the other L-Gates in the galaxy are showing increased signs of activity as well. At the rate their self-correcting software is making adjustments, their maintenance cycles should also terminate within a matter of years.

texts.zh:
虽然我们已经掌握了不少关于L-星门的知识和科技，但目前我们手中并没有L-星门。

如果我们要继续进行计划的话，就必须从某个星系中取得L-星门的控制权。
texts.en:
Although we have accumulated a lot of information about the L-Gates and their technology, we are not in possession of an actual gate.

Before this project can continue, we must gain ownership of a system with an L-Gate.

label.zh: 那我们就想办法控制一个L-星门好了。
label.en: Then we shall secure an L-Gate.

label.zh: 虽然听上去挺有意思，但我们不能再让这种事情分散我们的精力了。
label.en: An interesting diversion, but it ends now.
